lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point. Each column contains 3-5 distinct maxima with relatively uniform vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical lineaments of elevated luminance intersect the centroid clusters, forming a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature with a high-contrast luminance gradient (light upper, shadowed lower) runs from the mid-body toward the caudal peduncle, parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 low-contrast, high-luminance pixel clusters within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast, dark rectangular feature is attached to the dermis at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin, consistent with an external telemetry device.
